pages.text: The Overworld is sheltered by the Stillness. Live Bloom cannot normally take hold here. Your home needs neither liberation nor fuel to remain sheltered.
pages.title: A field guide
A quiet world
pages.text: Look for small pale, cold traces on natural ground. Harvest this dormant tissue for flakes. It does not spread or infect. Newly explored Overworld terrain contains these traces; colonies whose hearts are gone leave the same

pages.title: From traces to instruments
pages.text: A book and a dormant flake make this journal. The assay kit also uses a raw flake rather than active essence. Neither needs a working machine.

pages.title: From traces to instruments
pages.text: Build a Stillness Dynamo and an Essence Condenser from ordinary iron, copper, glass, redstone and a furnace. Place them next to each other. Feed a flake into each: the dynamo burns one into 4000 FE; the condenser spends that power

pages.title: From traces to instruments
pages.text: and its second flake to make one assimilation essence in ten seconds. Other FE generators can supply the condenser instead.

pages.title: Your first deployment
pages.text: Make the terminal using refined essence, then complete Field Survey to open remote deployments. You do not need to defeat an Overworld boss to leave home.

pages.title: Your first deployment
pages.text: The first survey is practice with routes, checkpoints and extraction. The hostile frontier is elsewhere. Other dimensions still require preparation, repeated successful expeditions and their own bound guardian to become safe
Your discoveries belong to you. A replacement book remembers them.
